faq.question: Do you only photograph weddings?
faq.answer: No, we cover weddings and family sessions across Northumberland, both in the same relaxed documentary style.

faq.question: Will you ask us to pose?
faq.answer: No, our style is documentary, so your day unfolds naturally while we quietly capture it as it happens.

faq.question: Do you work across all of Northumberland?
faq.answer: Yes, we photograph weddings and family sessions across Northumberland.

faq.question: Can we get a printed album?
faq.answer: Yes, your albums are printed in the UK, so your photographs become something you can hold and keep.

faq.question: What happens when we first get in touch?
faq.answer: Send a message about your wedding or family session, and tell us your date and what you have in mind.
